LanguageData.BOR_Bench_IV.label: umbral fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_Bench_IV.description: A work station for assembling Tenebrite-based technology.
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_IV.label: lesser umbral forge
LanguageData.BOR_Forge_IV.description: Used to compose Neutronium into usable items.
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_IV.label: umbral medical fabricator
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineBench_IV.description: A workbench well-stocked with all manner of mind-bending equipment designed to produce various drugs, often stimulants or medicines.
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_IV.label: umbral hydrogrower
LanguageData.BOR_HydroponicsBasin_IV.description: An ultratech nutrient bath commonly used to grow medicinal plants or natural stimulants, allowing for them to sprout and flourish at such a frightening rate the naked eye can observe its growth. Stripped down to lower the cost of manufacture there is no emergency power cell within the basin, which means that in the event of power loss the plants within will begin to die, and may die completely if power is not restored in a timely manner.
